name_zh: 也门·萨利赫：部落统一与阿拉伯春天内战霍乱
name_en: Yemen Saleh: Tribal Unity & Arab Spring Civil War Cholera
description_zh: 阿里·阿卜杜拉·萨利赫 (1947-2017) 也门总统 (1990-2012)，1990年统一南北也门，部落平衡治国，2011阿拉伯春天爆发抗议，2012年权力移交，内战霍乱灾难中2017年被胡塞武装杀害。
description_en: Ali Abdullah Saleh (1947-2017) Yemen President (1990-2012), 1990 unified North South Yemen, tribal balance governance, 2011 Arab Spring protests erupted, 2012 power transfer, civil war cholera disaster killed by Houthis 2017.
reason_zh: 萨利赫代表部落社会如何在现代国家框架内维持统一，展示了阿拉伯春天如何在部落分裂社会中演变为长期内战与人道灾难，其生死折射也门国家建构的根本困境。
reason_en: Saleh represents how tribal society maintains unity within modern state framework, demonstrating how Arab Spring evolved into prolonged civil war and humanitarian disaster in tribally fragmented society, his life and death reflecting Yemen state-building fundamental dilemma.
steps_zh: 研究萨利赫早年部落酋长之子与军官晋升
分析1990年南北也门统一与部落平衡权术
探讨2011阿拉伯春天抗议与海湾合作委员会调解
评估2012权力移交哈迪与胡塞崛起内战霍乱
总结部落统一阿拉伯春天内战霍乱对也门国家建构的毁灭性打击
steps_en: Study Saleh early tribal chief son and officer rise
Analyze 1990 North South Yemen unification and tribal balance statecraft
Explore 2011 Arab Spring protests and GCC mediation
Evaluate 2012 power transfer to Hadi and Houthi rise civil war cholera
Summarize tribal unity Arab Spring civil war cholera devastating blow to Yemen state-building
expected_zh: 理解部落平衡如何在现代国家中既是稳定基石又是分裂根源，掌握阿拉伯春天在部落社会中异化为内战的机制，评估也门重建的根本障碍。
expected_en: Understand how tribal balance is both stability foundation and fragmentation root in modern state, grasp Arab Spring mutation into civil war in tribal society mechanism, evaluate Yemen reconstruction fundamental obstacles.
case_zh: 1990 统一；2011 春天；2012 移交；2017 被杀。部落统一阿拉伯春天内战霍乱范式永存。
case_en: 1990 unification; 2011 Spring; 2012 transfer; 2017 killed. Tribal unity Arab Spring civil war cholera paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Yemeni Tribal Statecraft / Arab Spring Transition
cross_cultural_impact: Tribal unity; Arab Spring; civil war; cholera; Gulf mediation
